decisions.reason: A coupling protection cap is a simple accessory that complements the core trailer business, needs little knowledge beyond what the firm already holds, and costs almost nothing to keep in the range.
Box car trailers are the firm's core competence and were featured on the home page, so the firm can read and act on their market feedback well.
A car transporter builds on the firm's trailer production know-how, but it is a more specialised niche with a dedicated page only, so the risk of dropping it is moderately higher.
Low-bed trailers sit squarely within the firm's existing production and service knowledge and received home page prominence, which points to continued commitment.
High covers are a closely related extension of the trailer range that the firm can assimilate and improve easily, and the series was promoted on the home page.
A second box trailer series uses the firm's core knowledge, though overlap with Product B could eventually lead to consolidating the two lines.
